styles.name: The Hatastic Hat
styles.description:
The Hatastic Hat. A pain-and-a-half to craft.
Stubborn, specific, with thinking monolithic.

Not deigning to be made, you just may hear it say,
"No, my crafter. Not here, at least not on this day."

Days of waiting, 'til it finally acceded,
"I have arrived, you're welcome," it spoke, conceited.

The Highlanders they clapped, the hat arrived at last,
On this their day of Sun, and in their grasslands, vast.

- Q.M.

The Small Haberdasher's Geist,
Frightful and scary
Is not such a threat
If ye make it yer quarry.

Seek ye dungeons aplenty,
Both uber and cold,
If another clue
Is what ye wish to behold.

But cover-not yer peepers
with any but these,
For the geists' shimmer
Camoflagues them with ease.

- Q.M.

styles.description: It highly anticipates closing the chapters on a few life stories.

styles.name: Haunted Hook
styles.description: To be fair, losing your head like this must be very distressing.

styles.name: Butchery Blade
styles.description: Hunger is the only thing it knows, but it knows it all too well.

styles.name: Raevensglaive
styles.description: Misconstrued as a weapon of ill-omen, it has long been wielded against the darkness.

styles.name: Noxious Nightfang
styles.description: Beware that which slithers in the dark, it's fangs glistening with venom.

styles.name: Revenant Reaver
styles.description: Borne into battle by many seasoned veterans.

styles.name: Crowing Rake
styles.description: It takes cruel glee in every wound it causes.

styles.name: Rancor's Rune
styles.description: Once a protective glyph, it is now associated with the curse that befell the Golden Vale.

styles.name: Hangnail Hook
styles.description: Fashioned with bodily harm in mind.

styles.name: Ceaseless Stricture
styles.description: At least in life its badgering would stop long enough for it to draw breath.

styles.name: Soulsap Spear
styles.description: With each assault on a mortal coil, it sucks out a tiny portion of the soul within.

styles.name: Flanged Soulflayer
styles.description: Created to fight the undead, it chastises evil spirits that refuse to leave the mortal plane.

styles.name: Baneful Bore
styles.description: Finds a way past any defense, always reaching for the heart of the matter.

styles.name: Soulstone Skewer
styles.description: Empowered by dark magics to steal the lifeforce of those it wounds.

styles.name: Gloomgaze Glaive
styles.description: The patterns on its blade resemble a shifting eye, studying its surroundings.

styles.name: Grim Razor
styles.description: The intricate blade looks perfect for sacrifices and other such unwholesome activities.

styles.name: Bone-Studded Bardiche
styles.description: An otherwise plain weapon, the chunks of bone embedded in it hint at its sinister origins.

styles.name: Shadowfall
styles.description: Rumored to have been used by Shadow gods.

styles.name: Cursed Halberd
styles.description: Distribute the curse evenly between all of your enemies.

styles.name: Stormdance Snowflake
styles.description: There is no safe space where evil can hide from its just fury.

styles.name: Fossil-Iced Fork
styles.description: It's prongs are frozen stalagmites, formed over millenia.

styles.name: Chilling Grasp
styles.description: Combines an ultra-strong pincer and a chilling aura to restrain and immobilize with ease.

styles.name: Glacier Trekker
styles.description: Equally useful as a walking stick, climbing hook, and wild beast deterrent.

styles.name: Rending Frostendrils
styles.description: So cold, it's blades cut without being felt.

styles.name: Hoary Harpoon
styles.description: Extensively used by shore-dwelling Permafrost tribes for fishing and protection from predators.

styles.name: Slush Pylon
styles.description: Nobody asked for it, but you're bringing extra and they're going to have to deal with it.

styles.name: Galenor's Scalance
styles.description: Whether Frostflake was given the scale or stole it is a matter of heated debate to this day.

styles.name: Frozen Envy
styles.description: Whatever the frozen ichor on the tip is, it radiates palpable malevolence.

styles.name: Berg Breacher
styles.description: Capable of piercing the densest ice in Permafrost.

styles.name: Glacial Grapplepike
styles.description: Caterkiller hunters employ this tool to immobilize the beast's head first, or dispatch it if subdual fails.

styles.name: Azure Auspice
styles.description: A shamanic spear, used in rituals to predict blizzards and ensure successful hunts and expeditions.

styles.name: Sheet Sleet
styles.description: Like the winter's chill, it finds a way to pierce to the bone.

styles.name: Silver Sliver
styles.description: A long spear comes in handy when fending off the predators of the Permafrost.

styles.name: Jagged Ice Lance
styles.description: Likely employed by Frost Fae knights mounted on Frosthounds, or maybe Polar Worms.

styles.name: Permafrost Pilum
styles.description: At the height of its might, the Frost Fae empire stretched across Permafrost.

styles.name: Hailstorm Halberd
styles.description: Frostflake's teachings made the Frost Fae mighty and wise.

styles.name: Hoarfiend's Bane
styles.description: A culture's weapons will evolve to deal with the threats of the time.

styles.name: Classy Glass Gouge
styles.description: Its ethereal aesthetic doesn't obviate its ultimate purpose.

styles.name: Lashing Leaf
styles.description: Pruned from a tree with a really aggressive attitude towards passers-by.

styles.name: Swinging Sapling
styles.description: Perfectly balanced to score some home runs.

styles.name: Faeridot Flanger
styles.description: Crafted from a gemstone imbued with the power to fight the Shadows.

styles.name: Green Glaivelle
styles.description: One of a twinned pair wielded by the Fae warrior priestess Ahn-Xyrli, and an integral part of her legend.

styles.name: Bine Billhook
styles.description: Wild Fae seed their forest with plants that can be used as weapons at a moment's notice.

styles.name: Gempod Javelin
styles.description: Painstakingly grown by the Fae, gempods have many practical applications.

styles.name: Spirey Sapling
styles.description: An uprooted tree can be a viable weapon, for one the right size.

styles.name: Luciferin Lance
styles.description: Fossilized aeons ago, this insect inexplicably continues to emit its signature glow.

styles.name: Pinegrove Pike
styles.description: Bears the standard of a lesser clan of wild fae.

styles.name: Crystalline Flame
styles.description: A spirit of fire, captured in a gleaming crystal.

styles.name: Bold Gold
styles.description: Quite eye-catching, almost garishly so.

styles.name: Faewing Sting
styles.description: A general rule to follow in the forests of the Fae: the prettier the bug, the more lethal its bite.

styles.name: Green Legion Glaive
styles.description: The Green Legion mediated in many conflicts between Fae and non-Fae.

styles.name: Ironleaf Spear
styles.description: Believed to be of ancient Fae manufacture.

styles.name: Fallen Leaf
styles.description: Issued to elite combat units who were not expected to return from battle.

styles.name: Willow Widow
styles.description: Many widowed Fae embark on journeys of mourning and self-discovery.

styles.name: Tangle Raker
styles.description: Fae use longer weapons to clear brush to avoid ambushes by hidden predators.

styles.name: Sanctum Sinari
styles.description: Sinari are highly-prized heirlooms handed down through lineages of royal custodians.

styles.name: Searshield Spear
styles.description: Burns its way through any barrier to torch the target beyond.

styles.name: Piercing Pyrelance
styles.description: It's superheated point easily penetrates any armor with ease.

styles.name: Dinky Drake Dart
styles.description: The tiny firebrand on it is really hoping you are going to throw it. Weee!

styles.name: Engraved Dragonfang
styles.description: Painstakingly etched by hand, the intricate patterns lend it a hypnotizing beauty.

styles.name: Enraged Ember
styles.description: Ready to explode at the slightest provocation.

styles.name: Ash Splinter
styles.description: The smoldering remains of a cursed tree spirit, exorcised millenia ago by Za-Hadeen's purifying flame.

styles.name: Dragon Hunter Harpoon
styles.description: Handy as a melee weapon, but it's true power is revealed when used with the appropriate launching mechanism.

styles.name: Fyrfalkan
styles.description: A famed Draccoon weapon, it is said to never miss an airborne target when hurled.

styles.name: Torchentine
styles.description: Burn and bore, scorch and spear, bring your foes despair and fear.

styles.name: Pyrewing Polearm
styles.description: Hastens your foes along their journey into the unexplored afterlife.

styles.name: Hellion Halberd
styles.description: Casually creates chaos in enemy formations.

styles.name: Pyric Polearm
styles.description: Its superheated tip is great for tackling heavily armored foes.

styles.name: Muzzled Maulberd
styles.description: Unleash this beast of a weapon on your foes and watch them scamper like vermin before a charging dragon.

styles.name: Ashen Agitator
styles.description: When all that is left is ash in the wind, its work will be done.

styles.name: Heartburn Halberd
styles.description: Believed by some to heat the blood of a struck foe, leading to a swift and agonizing death.

styles.name: Dormant Drakelance
styles.description: The draconic spirit within slumbers, its flame dim and fickle.

styles.name: Lava Lance
styles.description: Its intense heat can pierce through dragon scales, making it a great jousting weapon.

styles.name: Guided Flameglaive
styles.description: The handle on the head expands the wielder's possibilities in combat.

styles.name: Volatile Voulge
styles.description: These weapons are notorious for exploding in battle, so use it with care.

styles.name: Igneous Injector
styles.description: Delivers intense heat through its specially-designed head.

styles.name: Blazing Halberd
styles.description: Manifested a burning desire for combat!

styles.name: Data-Driven Drill
styles.description: Bores down into the meat of the matter, always accounting for rounding errors.

styles.name: Laser-Lined Lever Rod
styles.description: Pries open even the most stubborn of Amperium drones.

styles.name: Rage Relic
styles.description: Kami may pass from this world, but their legacy lives on in the mortals they inspire.

styles.name: Voltaic Voulge
styles.description: Your foes will be quite shocked when they encounter its business end.

styles.name: Plasmium Powerpike
styles.description: This Amperium prototype hasn't seen wide circulation yet, making you an unwitting test subject.

styles.name: Diode Dagger
styles.description: You would think foes would learn to avoid the angry flashing light, but they don't seem to learn.

styles.name: Citrineon Circuitbreaker
styles.description: Designed to easily interface with any robotic entity.

styles.name: Monocular Mandrel
styles.description: Originally an autonomous drone in the Amperium military-industrial complex, it has proven equally adept at dismantling its creations.

styles.name: Viridium Virolance
styles.description: Enhanced with an array of exotic software and hardware viruses designed specifically to disrupt Amperium combat units.

styles.name: Luminous Liberty
styles.description: Inspire those around you by brandishing this emblem of the Hero of Luminopolis.

styles.name: Tri-Vector Troubleshooter
styles.description: It's good to keep your options open when dealing with particularly persistent bugs.

styles.name: Splintered Neonlance
styles.description: Even in its ruined state it remains a formidable weapon. Imagine if it were reforged to its former glory.

styles.name: Sheetmetal Shear
styles.description: An industrial-grade metal cutter stolen from an Amperium manufacturing facility and put to better use by the Resistors.

styles.name: Stream Spider
styles.description: The lights may be out, but this dark husk remains as deadly as ever.

styles.name: Memory Matchstick
styles.description: Just the thing for when you need to burn the servers down.

styles.name: SP-34-R
styles.description: Yet another Amperium military industrial complex prototype that never saw mass production.

styles.name: Radiating iRod
styles.description: Not its intended purpose, but it can be used to poke both eyes out at the same time.

styles.name: Khangyar of Fervor
styles.description: The Khangyar, or Journey Staff, is bestowed by the Kami unto those who exemplify their embodied virtue.

styles.name: Lightcasting Luminlance
styles.description: Cobbled together from Resistor technology, it drives the point home that the Amperium are not welcome in Luminopolis.

styles.name: Neon Needle
styles.description: Interfaces surprisingly well with robot drones - or surprisingly badly, if you're the drone being inter-faced with it.

styles.name: Buggy Botzapper
styles.description: Designed to decommission marauding robots, but sometimes just fries their chips through and through.

styles.name: Circuit Sunderer
styles.description: Comes equipped with a rotatory energy saw capable of cracking the toughest robotic armor plating.

styles.name: Kami-Infused Krissain
styles.description: Inhabited by a powerful kami, it relishes combat with its hated enemies.

styles.name: Plunge Plug
styles.description: Your foes are in for a real shock when you poke this into their eye sockets.

styles.name: Firewall Stormer
styles.description: Forcefully overwhelms any packet filters surrounding its target's data structure.

styles.name: Sparking Spear
styles.description: Wrapped in resistive polymers to keep you safe from electrical blowbacks.

styles.name: Pronged Peril
styles.description: Constant variation in attack vectors is a reliable strategy when dealing with advanced point-defense systems.

styles.name: Hard Data Point
styles.description: The numbers don't lie: stabbings in your vicinity are expected to rise by at least 72%.

styles.name: In-Line Video Connector
styles.description: Enables you to change your foes' perspectives - they can either see things your way, or their outlook on life can turn pretty grim.

styles.name: Plasma Pike
styles.description: Dispatch droids and maim machines with this supple superheated halberd.

styles.name: Flaming Filament
styles.description: Its edge is composed of a conductor hot enough to melt lesser metals.

styles.name: Shock Shear
styles.description: It slices, it dices, it makes your foes cry, all from a safe distance.

styles.name: Crossfade
styles.description: Warranty does not cover electric components.

styles.name: Rainbow Sugar Rush
styles.description: Swiftly swab your way to sweetest victory.

styles.name: Sprinkle-Speckled Spear
styles.description: This sweet treat will make your foes taste bitter defeat.

styles.name: Candorian Fishing Spear
styles.description: A design based on an apex predator of Candorian 'waters', it is close to parfaition.

styles.name: Pinkie Pike
styles.description: Overwhelm your foes with it's supreme sweetness.

styles.name: Cherry Champion
styles.description: Favoured by Candorian warriors everywhere.

styles.name: Chocolate Chunker
styles.description: Not the type of candy you want to cut your teeth on.

styles.name: Corn Holer
styles.description: Easily perforates flesh, bones, and teeth.

styles.name: Partisan Piroulette
styles.description: Looks like its last victim bit off more of the blade than they could chew.

styles.name: Sharp Mint Spear
styles.description: So sharp and strong, it will have your foes sucking in their breath.

styles.name: Plum Gum Pike
styles.description: It looks squishy, but the rock sugar crystals on its surface leave deep lacerations.

styles.name: Soft Serf Spetum
styles.description: Best used on foes' faces for a hearty helping of brain freeze.

styles.name: Cenobite Spade
styles.description: Corrupt and drunk with power, few Cenobites remember their rigorous training with this weapon.

styles.name: Gumdrop Kebab
styles.description: Bad for the teeth of your enemies.

styles.name: Sheenshard Shank
styles.description: Despite its radiant origin, it does its job best in shadows.

styles.name: Highwind Hand-Dart
styles.description: This lightweight javelin always has the winds blowing in its favor.

styles.name: Skyshaper Spear
styles.description: A relic of the Radiant Realm, said to allow its wielder to conjure anything from a gentle breeze to a monstrous monsoon.

styles.name: Gale Glaive
styles.description: Infused with the blessings of Cygnus and Scintilla, it can call upon the might of winds and sky at a moment's notice.

styles.name: Broad Daylance
styles.description: Anything caught out in the open is a sitting duck to it.

styles.name: Sun Scarab Spear
styles.description: An ancient offering to the Sun Goddess, it regularly finds its way back to the mortal realm in times of strife.

styles.name: Righteous Retributor
styles.description: Punishment served from a radiant blade.

styles.name: Magus Macaxe
styles.description: This weapon is serious business, so no monkeying about with it.

styles.name: Dancing Thunder
styles.description: Flits effortlessly past enemy defenses, landing hits with devastating effect.

styles.name: Stratospear
styles.description: Streamlined for ranged combat, it flies unimpeded through the air in search of its target.

styles.name: Song of Sanctuary
styles.description: Emits a soft, almost inaudible tune that echoes in the hearts of the valiant.

styles.name: Sunsheen Spear
styles.description: Sunlight plays over its surfaces, giving it a subtle glow.

styles.name: Sunshimmer
styles.description: Force your way through your foes like sunlight through the clouds overhead.

styles.name: Radiant Pointer
styles.description: The type of weapon that is always leading the charge.

styles.name: Cerulean Sliver
styles.description: Believed to be a tiny piece of the sky that crystallized and fell to earth.

styles.name: Dawn Watcher
styles.description: In the Sun's absence, mortals must remain ever vigilant of the encroaching Shadows.

styles.name: Solar Sentry
styles.description: A common sight in days gone by, when the Sun Goddess's followers kept the Sky Realms safe.

styles.name: Sunfire Scimistave
styles.description: Shaped from a sunbeam captured and congealed by magical means.

styles.name: Sunbird Spear
styles.description: Some believe Cygnus served the Moon Goddess before becoming a Celestial Paragon.

styles.name: Sol Blazer
styles.description: When shadow reigns, a hero will descend from the Sky Realm to put an end to death's toll.

styles.name: Skyshard Svarta
styles.description: The blade of this rare weapon is crafted with refined crystallized clouds.

styles.name: Schism Seeker
styles.description: Created to seek and seal weaknesses in the fabric of reality, it can also be used to rip them open.

styles.name: Radiant Restrainer
styles.description: Capable of capturing foes with less-than-lethal force.

styles.name: Cloud Piercer
styles.description: Leave no cloud out.

styles.name: Celestial Fury
styles.description: Sharp as heavenly justice itself.

styles.name: Pincer Prong
styles.description: Makes catching your foes off-guard and pinning them a snap.

styles.name: Fish Foe
styles.description: The bane of all aquatic existence.

styles.name: Seaweed Whacker
styles.description: A highly effective weapon, just don't let Phyconidia see you abusing its power.

styles.name: Fishing Pike
styles.description: As they say, it takes a fish to catch a bigger fish.

styles.name: Harmonious Harpoon
styles.description: Blessed by ancient spirits, it safeguards sailors from the perils of the oceans

styles.name: Sharkened Shoreraider
styles.description: Despite it's appearance, it doesn't seem to have been made, or ever seen wielded, by any Sharkhan.

styles.name: Depth Dredger
styles.description: It appears to have been some form of underwater gardening tool at one point.

styles.name: Bitone Beak
styles.description: Sharp enough to open not one, but two cans.

styles.name: Bait and Stitch
styles.description: Lure your foes close with this enticing spear, then reel them in or run them through.

styles.name: Teeny Pterodactyl
styles.description: Its hunger is only equalled by its cuteness.

styles.name: Squall Skewer
styles.description: It never hurts to have a reliable ally in the stormy seas.

styles.name: Seafoam Shard
styles.description: The force of the tides captured in a singular focal point.

styles.name: Tranquil Trident
styles.description: Not to be used for stirring up trouble or roiling people's tempers.

styles.name: Piercing Polyp
styles.description: This strange coral colony grew around a mysterious aqueous crystal.

styles.name: Polly's Poker
styles.description: Some parrots prefer to get up close and personal.

styles.name: Wintertide Trident
styles.description: Retrieved from the frozen Northern Seas, it appears to have some connection to cold currents.

styles.name: Kraken Killer
styles.description: Kraken, Leviathan, Megalodon, any oversized marine menace will do, really.

styles.name: Kaboom Harpoon
styles.description: Don't point it anywhere except overboard. Seriously.

styles.name: Tines of the Tides
styles.description: A riding tide raises all boats, but a titanic tsunami clears the coast.

styles.name: Oceanblight Blade
styles.description: Made from an unknown metal that shines with a blue-green glow.

styles.name: Ghostly Roger
styles.description: Stealing wheat and barley and all the other grains.

styles.name: Cosmic Wedge
styles.description: Discovered in an ancient crater, it is presumed to be of extra-Trovian origin.

styles.name: Dino Horn Halberd
styles.description: It is unclear what species they belonged to, but their effectiveness is undisputed.

styles.name: Stone Stabber
styles.description: You know it's a classic when the design stays mostly the same for 10,000 years.

styles.name: Spearing Bill
styles.description: No need to reinvent the wheel when nature freely provides it.

styles.name: Helping Hand
styles.description: When life gives you small hands, overcompensate with tools.

styles.name: Plated Pike
styles.description: Studded with massive stegosaurus plates, it provides both defense and offense.

styles.name: Ceratops Trident
styles.description: Triple the stabbing power, in one tidy package.

styles.name: Sea Stinger
styles.description: This giant eurypterid is bad news for anything that gets in your way.

styles.name: Starglass Stabber
styles.description: Starglass tools and weapons are vastly superior to wood, bone, and stone ones.

styles.name: A very Rare Bird
styles.description: You are so lucky to have it!

styles.name: Skullharpoon
styles.description: It is not easy to survive in a jungle.

styles.name: Envenomed Impaler
styles.description: Handle with care.

styles.name: Ley Leveller
styles.description: Handy when you need to rearrange the feng shui of a battlefield to favour your side.

styles.name: Banisher's Beacon
styles.description: Most households of the Reng Empire had at least one of these lanterns hung somewhere prominent as a ward against evil spirits.

styles.name: Horns of Yun Bao
styles.description: From dawn til dusk Yun Bao tirelessly toils, renewing the soil that all plants may flourish.

styles.name: Brand of Banishment
styles.description: Deals no damage to the physical body, only to the evils hidden inside it.

styles.name: Dissident Dragontongue
styles.description: Although not all Dragon Ogres betrayed their oaths, those that didn't were quickly destroyed by their perfidious peers.

styles.name: Jadeleaf Janga
styles.description: An ancient weapon design from Reng, it is a priceless example of stoneshaping techniques from the early days of the Empire.

styles.name: Broadleaf Guandao
styles.description: Its oversized blade is perfect for chopping down armored foes.

styles.name: Hooked Halberd
styles.description: The hook under the head can be used to snag weapons or throw enemies off-balance.

styles.name: Imperial Dagger Axe
styles.description: This mass-produced weapon carved out the foundation of what would become the Reng Empire.

styles.name: Common Dagger-Axe
styles.description: Predating the empire, its condition is a testament to the craftsmanship involved its creation.

styles.name: Crescent Halberd
styles.description: In time, dagger-axes gave way to weapons better suited to slashing attacks.

styles.name: Dual Crescent Halberd
styles.description: As with halberds elsewhere, the evolution of armor and tactics spawned countless variants of mainstay formation weapons.

styles.name: Irradiant Spear
styles.description: Doubles a handy grabber tool too.

styles.name: Irradiant Justice
styles.description: A favored tool of the Irradiant Sky Admirals and Invaders.

styles.name: Spear of the Irradiant Giants
styles.description: A symbol of the Irradiant Giant's superiority.

styles.name: Sundercharged Bident
styles.description: Sundercharge Crystals are useful in all kinds of ways, but they always seem to find their way into weapons.

styles.name: The Sunderer
styles.description: As dangerous as its namesake.

styles.name: Ashen Justice
styles.description: The ultimate weapon forged by the Ashen, too bad they can't figure out how to use it properly.

styles.name: Handy Toothpick
styles.description: Budgiz is as likely to play with it as use it, but he always leaves them lying about when he's finished with them.

styles.name: Blastflower Beacon
styles.description: The most obvious material from the Ashen Wastes to weaponize.

styles.name: Ashen Stabber
styles.description: For those who just love stabbing.

styles.name: Spear of the Ashen Wastes
styles.description: A symbol of the Ashen Waste's resilience.

styles.name: Skybreaker
styles.description: Rumored to have started the Sundering.

styles.name: Sunfury
styles.description: Forged in the furnaces of dawn.

styles.name: Litigator's Litany
styles.description: Fight back with a relentless and rhythmic barrage of well-planned, decisive attacks.

styles.name: Indecisive Indicators
styles.description: Your enemies will feel your wrath, one way or the other.

styles.name: Sunderer's Picker-Upper
styles.description: Doubles a handy grabber tool too.

styles.name: Pinchy Poker
styles.description: May have many tiny aliens telling you about the claw.

styles.name: Phosphorescent Pike
styles.description: Bring along your own source of Light.

styles.name: Hooked Harpoon
styles.description: Useful for the one that didn't get away.

styles.name: Shroom Spear
styles.description: Keep a handy snack on hand.

styles.name: Suncrest Spear
styles.description: The dawn will break - and all the Shadows will too.

styles.name: Bejeweled Bewitcher
styles.description: Encrusted with gems, like the inside of Geode.

styles.name: Ominous Presence
styles.description: Wherever you go, whatever you do, it lingers behind you, just out of sight.

styles.name: Risen Sunvaulter
styles.description: It took a leap of faith to launch you all the way across space.

styles.name: Quirky Crescent
styles.description: Half a moon is all that was left after the Shadows made off with the rest.

styles.name: Quarry Hunter
styles.description: Search the depths for a prize anyone would love on their mantle.

styles.name: Nebulous Void
styles.description: Shadows lurk just beyond the horizon.

styles.name: Builder's Heart
styles.description: He left behind everything he had on the planet he loved best.

styles.name: Fragment of Ancients
styles.description: The ones from before knew how to spearhead an issue, even if it meant their lives.

styles.name: Monolithic Lance
styles.description: The ancient six traded their lives and left a peace.

styles.name: Molten Corer
styles.description: The center is infused with the fire of ancients.

styles.name: Watchful Wrecker
styles.description: Catch yourself before you wreck yourself.

styles.name: Death Knell's Grapnel
styles.description: The only thing that follows lies six feet under.

styles.name: Crowned Headcrusher
styles.description: The Ancients are dead. Long live the Ancients.

styles.name: Thundering Tombstoner
styles.description: Here lies your foes, crushed by their own epitaph.

styles.name: True and Trident
styles.description: Classics are classics for a reason.

styles.name: Crystaltripartite
styles.description: Deadly elegance.

styles.name: Runic Pointy Stick
styles.description: Simple, yet powerful.

styles.name: Shepherd's Cane of the Depths
styles.description: Shines a dim light in the darkness of the depths.

styles.name: Abyssal Abomination
styles.description: Sticky, and fizzy to the touch.

styles.name: Zephyr Maximizer
styles.description: Maximize your damage.

styles.name: Stabilized Pyric Bell Fish
styles.description: Will not explode. Probably.

styles.name: Tormentor's Trident
styles.description: This piercing poker's purpose is the punishment of the peccant.

styles.name: Extinguisher
styles.description: For the Lunar Lancer, a spear to fight raging fires!

styles.name: Geodegem Spear
styles.description: For the Revenant, watch the gems glisten in the sunlight.

styles.name: Wave Commander's Trident
styles.description: Patent pending.

styles.name: Olhukoi's Fang
styles.description: Infused with moonsilver, it protects the rightful repose of the innocent.

styles.name: Sundisk Svarta
styles.description: Its sun-motif blade is highly ornate, but far from ceremonial.

styles.name: Forked Destiny
styles.description: Eager to pull yet more souls off the straight and narrow.

styles.name: Home-Made Gingerbread Halberd
styles.description: It almost seems a pity to bash your enemies with this confectionery masterpiece.

styles.name: Pining Pike
styles.description: This festive season, it yearns to reach out and touch someone.

styles.name: Improvised Remote Excavator
styles.description: Just light and throw to see your ore yields blow up.

styles.name: Trovian Turn-Pike
styles.description: It's always your turn if you dispatch your foes fast enough.

styles.name: Alien Probe
styles.description: Does not need to be plugged in.

styles.name: Jeweled Jolt
styles.description: Majestic, yet sharp and dangerous.

styles.name: Spirit's Scorn
styles.description: Sworn to bring ruin to those who destroyed the Sun Goddess's domain.

styles.name: Silver Spork
styles.description: This oversized stabbing implement is more suited to fine dining than combat.

styles.name: Star Stalker
styles.description: Not a face you want to encounter in a dark vent duct or abandoned space colony.

styles.name: Inimical Innoculator
